ending-2.text: Moving forward the humidity had changed, dust was in the air and moisture hit your skin. This place felt both wrong and right so you pushed forward against your instinct.

ending-3.text: Although dark you weren't fearful. Beams of light piercing the cave walls lit your way. A feeling of greating meaning possesed you.

ending-4.text: You then were confronted with a bend in the path. You hoped this bend would be the final.

ending-5.text: The bend led to an open room. One in which the visibility was low. Despite this you pushed forward feeling more confident than ever.

ending-6.text: As you pushed forward the dense dust began to give way to something man-made. You didn't know what but you knew you had to approach.

ending-7.text: Getting closer and closer the dust revealed a shrine with an empty pedestal. You wondered what belonged there and why your path took you here. You got closer.

ending-8.text: Being confronted with what was seeminly the end of your journey you realised you had taken an object with you. You didn't understand why at first but now it made sense, it was to be left there.
